description: This file declares functions and types related to packing operations in Vulkan backend for ATen library in PyTorch, including shader information retrieval and command recording for tensor data transformations.

methods.name: get_nchw_to_image_shader
methods.description: Retrieves shader info for converting NCHW tensor to image format.

methods.name: get_image_to_nchw_shader
methods.description: Retrieves shader info for converting image format to NCHW tensor.

methods.name: record_nchw_to_image_op
methods.description: Records Vulkan commands to convert NCHW tensor to image in GPU.

methods.name: record_image_to_nchw_op
methods.description: Records Vulkan commands to convert image to NCHW tensor in GPU.

methods.name: record_nchw_to_buffer_op
methods.description: Records Vulkan commands to convert NCHW tensor to buffer.

methods.name: record_buffer_to_nchw_op
methods.description: Records Vulkan commands to convert buffer to NCHW tensor.

methods.name: convert_image_channels_packed_to_height_packed
methods.description: Converts a packed image tensor to height-packed tensor.

methods.name: convert_image_channels_packed_to_width_packed
methods.description: Converts a packed image tensor to width-packed tensor.
